law: Use CloudKit JS to build a web interface that lets users access the same public and private databases as your CloudKit app running on iOS or macOS.
You must have an existing CloudKit app and enable web services to use CloudKit JS.
You’ll use Xcode to create your app’s containers and use CloudKit Dashboard to view the containers.
Use an API Token from a website or an embedded web view in a native app, or when you need to authenticate the user.
Use a server-to-server key to access the public database from a server process or script as an administrator.
To enable strict mode for an entire script, put “use strict” before any other statements.
Also, specify whether to use the development or production environment.
